reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: Unpleasant staff, I paid an extra 40€ for a bag too big while it is the size of a cabin suitcase. I don’t recommend this company.
reviews.author: Cesar J

reviews.title: Never buy!!!!
reviews.text: Please never buy this, especially when you have connected flights. I bought a ticket in January 2023 for the Juliaca-Lima flight. 5 days before departure, I decided to check the amount of luggage. When I went in, it was written that my flight was canceled without explaining the reasons. I didn't receive any email when I tried to get my money back, they offered me a discount on airline services that I can use until July 2022. How relevant!!! It's good that I checked, otherwise I would have missed the Lima-Paris flight and lost a lot of money
reviews.author: Ana

reviews.title: The absolute worst
reviews.text: The only good thing was that we arrived in time. The rest: grumpy no English speaking staff, discrimination of families with children, bad pilot, extra cost for handlugage although it was free, but Jetstar decided what defines a handlugage. I was not far away from canceling the trip at the airport. But I had my wife and daughter with me. We were not allowed to take the pram to the airport and had to pay for it as well. Don't care how cheap it is, just don't do it. They will find a way to charge additional costs. Fly with someone else.
reviews.author: Nils W

reviews.title: DO NOT USE THIS AIRLINE
reviews.text: if you do not check in and pay for your bags and seat before going to the airport they will charge you double the cost to do so at the check-in window. On my flight from Lima to Cusco I tried multiple times to pay in advance but the website would not allow me to finalize payment. When I got to the Lima airport I explained this and showed my attempts. They understood and allowed me to pay the online rate. Conversely, when the website would not allow me to complete the payment transaction and I explained the issue at the check-in window on the Cusco airport they ignored me and I ended up paying an extra $100 USD more than I would have had their website functioned properly. Ot was explained to me that the fees had just recently gone up a day or two prior and that in Lima they had charged me the full rate. I find this very hard to accept given that I only paid $30 USD in Lima and $200 in Cusco. I saw the agent I was dealing with giggling with the agent sitting next to her while she was dealing with my issue. Very untrustworthy. Would never again fly with this airline.
reviews.author: Mark D

reviews.title: Worst Airline in the world
reviews.text: STAY AWAY, I have been traveling extensively for at least 25 years in many different airlines, our flight from AER to SCL was delayed 9 hrs, they even had to change the boarding airport to EZE instead or AER, wheb I tried to change the flight it was impossible, no refund and no nothing, attention is the worst in the world, check in took 2.5 hrs at the airport, their team is slow and rude, the culture of this company is horrible, boarding took more than 1 hr and they even gave me a real boarding pass, this os the worst airline in the world, the price is expensive since you have to pay for everything, NEVER AGAIN.
reviews.author: George C.

reviews.title: The worst ever!
reviews.text: The airline from hell. They won't assume responsibility! They will not help or resolve or help resolve your issues, even when their airplanes are broken down and cancels and delays customers flights! They said they were not at fault for being late to my connecting flight to the US and I missed my flight! Had to purchase new tickets for $2K ... Hope no one flies with them, so that they go out of business!
reviews.author: Jose T

reviews.title: Horrible horrible airline, do not purchase!!!
reviews.text: Our flight was scheduled for 5 pm and when we got to the airport, the Jetsmart staff notified us that our flight would be delayed for 4.30 hours. We explained to them we had another international flight and they assured is we would make it. We didn’t leave until almost seven hours later. Unfortunately, we missed our international flight at 1255 am. We called the Jetsmart in Lima Perú and the lady was so rude and not even apologized. Instead, she said it was our fault and that there was absolutely nothing they could do. We ended up having to buy new tickets super expensive from another airline since we needed to go back to California. Please consider NOT TO FLY WITH JETSMART!!!!
reviews.author: Minerva L

reviews.title: Look out. The guys are trouble
reviews.text: They are out to get extra cash from you at every turn. They are so strict with carry on im supprised i didn't get charged extra for the pack of Rizzla in my back pocket. Also pure bad customer service.
reviews.author: Sam W

reviews.title: Jetsmart in Argentina
reviews.text: We booked 6 internal flights within Argentina as part of our trip including Patagonia. At this point we had not read any reviews on Jetsmart. When we did it was too late and we were very concerned our trip would be disrupted in some way. Two of our flight times were changed a few weeks before we travelled. This was a nuisance as we had to change some of our pick up / drop off arrangements. Our tip is not to finalise your airport taxis or onward connections until the last minute. We joined jetsmarts discount club which eliminated any hassle with baggage weight. One other tip, Jetsmart only accept cash for on board refreshments. We didn't initially realise we could carry on fluids with domestic flights which enabled us to be part self sufficient anyway. We can only speak for internal flights within Argentina the situation may differ elsewhere. The impression we got was of an airline and staff that are all trying very hard. The staff were all fantastic, We met a lot over six flights. The on line check in system was flawless and actually put to shame Iberia who we used for our international flights. Iberias system was terrible and caused us some issues! But that's another story.
reviews.author: Michael J
reviews.route: Buenos Aires - San Carlos de Bariloche

reviews.title: jetsmart is not stable anymore
reviews.text: I am flying Talara to Cusco so I booked 2 flights Talara-Lima-Cusco. Jetsmart cancelled my 19 pm flight Lima to Cusco so I have to spend a night in Lima and pay for accommodation or book in another airline. Cancelling or changing flight times has happened often lately so I have decided to make no more bookings with Jetsmart. Book Latam, less trouble.
reviews.author: manantialdrinker

reviews.title: Pray that nothing goes wrong...
reviews.text: I think JetSmart works fine if there is no problem, but god their customer service is horrific. They canceled our flight the day of, did not provide ANY support (hotel, food, ...) and only offered another flight 3 days later. When we declined, they said they wont pay for any of the extra expenses we had. Also, it's been 74 business days today, and we have not received the refund from the cancelled flight, despite at least a dozen calls and around 30 emails.
reviews.author: Pedro G

reviews.title: SCAM
reviews.text: The same day I purchased the tickets, I realized I had booked on the wrong date, so I asked for a date change( 26 Apr-26 June). According to the website, I should have paid just the difference ( if any). It turned out I had to pay for the total amount of the new trip! I refused to pay, and I booked the flight with another airline. I'll never book again with JS; I should have read the review before making the booking
reviews.author: Xentix

reviews.title: Worst experience ever!!!!
reviews.text: Absolutely the worst experience I've had in 50 years of flying. I've tried to contact this company on-line with my issues and complaints and of course, that part of the site does not work either! I could not check in on-line with for my wife and I and then got charged at the airport for the issues with JetSmart's web site. A complete disappointment and this will surely be my last time (as well as all my clients) I ever fly with JetSmart.
reviews.author: jason f

reviews.title: very poor customer service. only gave one star because I can't give zero
reviews.text: Very Very Very poor (lack of) customer service, and I didn't even get to fly with them!! I booked flights Lima to Cusco to trek to Machu Picchu, unfortunately the riots closed Cusco airport and Machu Picchu, I tried to cancel the flights but coudn't as you can only do online check in, not even manage the booking. Tried to contact jetsmart, but you can only get through to their contact form if you supply a South American phone number. Everything else (trip, hotels etc) was cancelled due to the riots closing Cusco airport, train services and Machu Picchu, yet the information I was finally able to get from jetsmart website was that the flights were NOT AFFECTED and so no refund was applicable! TV even showed piles of burning tyres in the middle of the runway at Cusco, so how was this flight not affected? I have been trying for four months to get a refund (I tried many times prior to the flight to cancel the tickets, and couldn't) but unless you have a South American phone number, you can't change/ cancel/ request a refund or even lodge a complaint. I have resorted to contacting jetsmart on instagram and have been told several times 'we have made the escalations to the area in charge', but all you get is an automated email saying it will be responded to in 72 hours.. 5 times so far! And if you use the 'quick response' tab at the bottom of the automated email, they send you a new automated email with a new case number saying it will be responded to in 72 hours. I have on one occas
reviews.author: Mike

reviews.title: Warning people off this airline as much as possible
reviews.text: I cannot warn people off this airline enough. They cancelled our flight an hour before departure on 1 January and the hoops that I am having to jump through to get my money back is beyond a joke! I fill in a form, they say the refund will be with me in 28 days, I fill in another form, nothing happens, I contact them on Facebook, they give me another form, and so it goes... Dont waste your time dealing with them, their incompetence is another level; refunding to a credit card is the easiet thing in the world. If you do have to get a refund, get proof of the fact that you are entitled to a refund and go straight to your credit card company
reviews.author: T_Daly

reviews.title: The worst airline I ever used
reviews.text: This is the worst airline I ever used, avoid at all cost. In the last three weeks I had two problems with them on two different flights. Firstly, they charged me USD$65 for a checked baggage on a short distance flight in spite of their website saying "from USD$13.50". I bought it online, not at the airport. The second problem I had with them was, that they left me at Bariloche airport saying that my ticket has been cancelled in spite of me having my boarding card on my phone! I paid for a checked baggage too and it's all gone. I had to buy another ticked for a late flight and I lost my hotel reservation I had for that night in Buenos Aires. I spoke with them for 30mins on the phone and they were not listening at all. I will never ever use this airline in the future. The worst experience ever.
reviews.author: camilozeta
reviews.route: San Carlos de Bariloche - Buenos Aires

reviews.title: Really Bad !
reviews.text: We flight from Lima to Cusco. Not organised checkin, our tour in a guichet and he send us to the next one for Cusco. The hostess in the next one asked for 10$ for the checkin, we explain that the checkin is included and we show our reservation. She took her phone then moved to the other guichet to take the next passenger (flight for Cusco as well) and we are waiting. We ask what’s going on and her collègue come to us to say your flight is closed. After being nervous they finished by register us for free as it’s included and we catches our flight. This company JetSmart is not a serious respectful airline company. We had a really bad expensive.
reviews.author: Miss TAIEB

reviews.title: Avoid this airline at all costs
reviews.text: Please stay away from this airline. Use LATAM or SKY instead if you're coming to Chile. They leave your luggage behind and don't take responsibility or try to help at all. They don't even have a real office at the airports or over the phone. Customer support is just a random Agency third party taking care of the calls. They're just not a real airline. All the passengers from our flight were missing their luggage and some of the locals claimed it always happens.
reviews.author: Stephanye L

reviews.title: DON'T BOOK WITH JETSMART!! SCAM, DELIBERATE & CONSTANT OVERBOOKING!!
reviews.text: I would never book with JetSmart again en wish I had read the comments before we booked. We had booked a flight one day before departure (it was a really expensive flight, and we now know that the flight was already overbooked when we made te reservation - by phone). So the nice lady on the phone asked a lot of money, which we paid, knowing we wouldn't be able to fly!! When we arrived at the airport, they just told us the flight was overbooked en there were no alternatives for the upcoming days (indeed, dayS). We had a connective flight the day after, so eventually we had to book another flight of 1200$ to get to Santiago. Luckily the staff of LATAM was so nice to help us, share their wifi, searched for solutions ... We immediately made a complaint but we didn't got any response ... (we sent them a couple of reminders) We tried calling, emailing, instagram ... Eventually we received a reaction on instagram. JetSmart would not give any compensation: so our tickets from JetSmart were not paid back (even though we were not allow on the plane) and there would be zero compensation for the tickets we had to book to get to Santiago ourselves ... So thanks to the deliberate choices of JetSmart, we lost almost 2000$ for a flight that usually costs around 100$. Since JetSmart doesn't respond, we are still trying to get our money back true legal procedures and consumer protection institutes (SERNAC in Chile). They told us JetSmart always overbooks their flights with 10 till 15 percent (
reviews.author: Sofie M

reviews.title: Didn't let us on the plane, no compensation
reviews.text: FRAUDS! Let all the passengers behind us on the plane, but not us. They said it's because they sold 60 seats to many. 60!! We were supposed to fly from Lima to Cusco and only hade tree days in Cusco, hotell booked and everything, and now they've put us on a flight in two days so we only get one day in Cusco but payed for tree. Won't give us our money back or any compensation. Asked to speak to the boss, and when we asked why they let other people on the plane but not us, she just turned around and walked away. Do not fly with them! The worst (non)flight experience of my life and the deserve to go bankrupt.
reviews.author: David H

reviews.title: Has to be the worst experience for flyers of just about any airline in the world.
reviews.text: Where do I begin? It is the worst airline ive ever had the opportunity to use, and I used it 3 times in south america. Each time there was a different issue. If you can compare and pay more for other airlines such as LATAM. Sky isnt much better. Couple of exceptional areas of horrendousness: 1. Seats do not recline, even upgraded seats. 2. They find every opportunity to make your experience miserable, whether its hand luggage or checked baggage windows being shut on take off. 3. Their systems to book and cancel flights are horrendous. Lets hope they dont cancel the flight on you, because you have to jump through hoops to get the money back,. 4. Return flight tickets, this is the only airline to give me an issue in booking return tickets in south america. I've yet to find the actual law/agreement that they reference and no other airline gave me this issue.
reviews.author: Douglas S

reviews.title: Top rate service......
reviews.text: We were on a charter flight with these guys, from check-in to disembarkation the service offered was top rate, the staff, were friendly and helpful, all in all a wonderful experience.
reviews.author: JnVSydney

reviews.title: 10 pm flight changed to 2 am flight
reviews.text: This company doesn’t have much professionalism. Not only did we not receive an email or notification about the change, there was no gate agents present until ten minutes after midnight for a flight that supposedly boards at 01:25. Technically there are suppose to offer accommodation or other forms of transportation at a 4 hour delay per Chile law… the delay was 3 hours and 45 minutes…. But as I type this waiting for our plane I think we’re going to be delayed more than that. It also rather sucked that the lack of gate agents meant we had to wait in the lobby without adequate seating, power supplies or heating as it was quite chilly out.
reviews.author: Ryan J

reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: They are the worst airline!! Don't fly with them!! They made us pay for a small guitarlele to take on board.. we talk about 50cm.. our only handluggage!! We asked to put it in our bag, but then they said it's not possible anymore!! So rude how they answered, no wonder they have such bad reviews!!
reviews.author: Miriam

reviews.title: Worst airline experience ever
reviews.text: Horrid...total effing clown car of a plane with utterly incompetent staff, garbage food, and broken toilet. Absolute crap.
reviews.author: Frequenttravellady

reviews.title: Horrible delays
reviews.text: I had booked a flight in the evening and was getting ready for the airport only to get an email saying that flight was delayed by 3 hrs. They did offer a refund, gift card or rebooking without charge. It would totally fine if this was an exception but based on my past flight data these delays are the norm. Unless you have an appetite for crazy delays i highly recommend against taking this airlines.
reviews.author: Harish Ramalingam

reviews.title: Dr.
reviews.text: This is by far the worst airline I have ever flown, including SPIRIT. not only do the nickle and dime you, but we had connecting flights and had to pick up out checked bags and pay all over again to recheck. If you had cardiac arrest I believe the defibrillator would be extra.
reviews.author: Scott H
reviews.route: San Carlos de Bariloche - Buenos Aires

reviews.title: Lost our checked in bag and now are not responding
reviews.text: Jetsmart has lost our bag and now is not responding for 3 days, even though they promised that they will arrive in the next day max. A bit sad that we have no idea what happens with our stuff during NYE.
reviews.author: Alex L

reviews.title: A budget airline - don’t expect much
reviews.text: We flew a total of four times with Jetsmart in the last month. A mixture of domestic and international flights. They are okay at best. A no frills airline. Their bag check-in queues were the most painful part of the experience. The inadequate staffing for bag check in at Santiago domestic terminal meant we (just) made our flight to Calama but our bag did not. This meant we had no change of clothes for four days. For several days afterwards, I imagined scenes of returning to that counter, asking for the manager and throwing various items at them. They got us out of a state of emergency in Cusco though so for that I am grateful. Overall would not fly with them again and would recommend others against using them too, unless you are traveling with carry-on baggage only, in which case they are okay.
reviews.author: lcar260

reviews.title: Not the best
reviews.text: this airline is quite good, but for us it was delayed seven hours, so it was in the morning. I would have expected some blankets for a night flight. the tables and benches are usually also untidy.
reviews.author: Advicer
